text: Integration gate complete. The pure line lexer, stateful block/sample/native parsers, exact message/native timelines, lossless raw session, trusted mono/binocular materializer, and FS2 adapter now compose end to end. Arbitrary byte partitioning equals whole-input framing; source locations, exact payload bytes, configuration revisions, GAZE/HREF/RAW, pupil representation, optional columns, dot/zero missingness, left/right identity, native event provenance, message offsets, unknown lines, and conversion SHA-256 remain explicit. HREF/RAW cannot become pixel Recording values; planned timing cannot be fabricated; EyeLink events cannot become DetectionResult. Full current io gates pass JVM 123/123 and Scala.js 109/109 with formatting, git diff hygiene, kernel purity, and module boundaries. Component and session mutation receipts demonstrate timestamp/order, message-offset, event-field, block-flush, blink-boundary/eye, and provenance guards are non-vacuous. Bounded-memory certification remains separately tracked by bd-01M039S0CB7KV64D9ZXPRPBP3D rather than overstated here.
